# seerr_user_requests (Data Source)

Get requests for a specific user from Seerr via `GET /api/v1/user/{userId}/requests`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_user_requests" "example" {
  user_id = 1
  take    = 20
  skip    = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user whose requests to retrieve.

### Optional

- `skip` (Number) Number of requests to skip (offset).
- `take` (Number) Number of requests to retrieve (page size).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for the data source.
- `page_info` (Attributes) Paging details for the returned requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--page_info))
- `requests` (Attributes List) List of requests made by the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests))

<a id="nestedatt--page_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `page_info`

Read-Only:

- `page` (Number) The current page number.
- `pages` (Number) Total number of pages.
- `results` (Number) Total number of results across all pages.


<a id="nestedatt--requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Date and time the request was created in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) The request ID.
- `is_4k` (Boolean) Whether the request is for 4K media.
- `media_id` (Number) Seerr media ID associated with the request.
- `media_type` (String) Media type (`movie` or `tv`).
- `status` (Number) Status of the request (1: Pending, 2: Approved, 3: Declined).
- `tmdb_id` (Number) TMDB ID of the media associated with the request.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the request was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
